0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The injured Yok Huy appears to be languishing in pain.

24.original: Search for the jar of pigment.

25.original: Deliver the jar of pigment to the injured Yok Huy.

48.original: Urrrgh... A moment, if you would, visitor. You see, I was en route to deliver pigment from Worlar's Echo to Sentinel just ahead.

49.original: But fool that I was, I let my guard down, and─<hex:021A020203>oogh<hex:021A020103>─when monsters attacked, I had no choice but to flee for my life, abandoning my rations and even my precious cargo.

50.original: The beasts can have the food for all I care, but that pigment is essential for the repair of our cave murals.

51.original: Thus I ask─aaagh!─no, I <hex:021A020203>beseech<hex:021A020103> you: go and retrieve the jar of pigment I left behind near the Sunken Stars!

52.original: You'll find the pigment lying around somewhere near the Sunken Stars. Nnngh, they got me good...

53.original: The pain has receded in the time you were away, if only a little. Have you found the pigment?

54.original: Yes, this is it! Full glad am I to see it again, and with nary a crack in the jar. This will be of great use to the repair efforts.

55.original: Though these particular murals are shielded from the sun and other elements, they still fade with time, and so require regular upkeep.

56.original: I had intended to take part in the repairs myself, but...yeowch! I'm afraid I must first tend to my wounds at Sentinel.
